title: OrgGraph graph snapshot
description: Raw, unversioned full-state snapshot within a declared scope (PRD §3, §5.1, E20). Produced by harvesters and the one-time legacy migration; validated by the app importer (PRD FR-6.8). Snapshots never carry validity fields — validity intervals are internal store representation created by the import (PRD FR-3.6).

source.description: Canonical source identifier (PRD E62): stable per provider, identical to the harvest-spec provider; key for provenance, partition, snapshot identity, chronology, and precedence. Free-form spellings/URLs are rejected — put the URL into sourceUrl.

sourceUrl.description: Source URL or display name (metadata only, PRD E62).

crawledAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the crawl/migration run WITH explicit offset or Z — offsetless values are rejected (PRD E50); meta.snapshot must equal its UTC minute.

snapshot.description: Snapshot stamp YYYYMMDD-HHMM in UTC — the UTC minute of crawledAt, validated by the importer (PRD FR-3.1, E50). Hard chronological import order applies only to root-free full states per (source, scope fingerprint); rooted/enrichment snapshots may import out of order and are ordered per visited edgeSource via instant monotonicity (PRD FR-6.9, E65).

registryVersion.description: Version of the registry the run was crawled against (PRD FR-6.1b).

allOf.$comment: Rooted snapshots must declare the actually visited source nodes as NON-EMPTY edgeSources (PRD E59, FR-6.8); the harvest spec reuses the scope def without this constraint because edgeSources is filled at run time.
Enrichment snapshots (empty nodeTypes, non-empty edgeTypes) must declare non-empty edgeSources — without visited sources there is no edge closure (PRD E59, FR-6.8).
Non-empty excluded requires explicit, NON-EMPTY traversalEdgeTypes — an empty or narrow traversal set could fail to expand the excluded subtree and falsely close its descendants (PRD FR-5.5, FR-5.7).

schema.description: Subset of the registry: only the types actually used, with full registry declarations (PRD FR-3.4). Structural conformance is validated here; that the entries actually match the curated registry is checked by the importer (PRD FR-6.8).

scope.description: Declares what this snapshot is a full state for; membership is evaluated on the pre-import stock (PRD FR-5.5, FR-5.5a).

excluded.description: Node ids acting as excluded subtree roots, e.g. failed fetches (PRD FR-5.7).

edgeSources.description: Visited source node ids: the snapshot is a full state of their outgoing edges of the declared edgeTypes, without their node type being subject to closure (PRD FR-5.5, E30, E59).

edgeTargets.description: Fully observed target container ids: their INCOMING edges of the declared edgeTypes were completely observed — counter-evidence enabling move-out closure in rooted snapshots (PRD FR-5.5, FR-5.5a); absent = no move-out closure (conservative).

traversalEdgeTypes.description: Edge types used ONLY to determine roots reachability (boundary traversal); they never become closure candidates. Defaults to edgeTypes when absent (PRD FR-5.5, E34).

authoritativeForSources.description: REQUEST to close facts for other sources, or ["*"] for all (PRD E37). Never effective from the file alone: the import activates it only after an explicit confirmation dialog naming the affected sources (PRD E46); absent or unconfirmed = only meta.source.

label.description: Canonical, versioned default display name (PRD FR-3.2, FR-4.2b).

props.description: Scalar values only (PRD FR-4.5): string, number, boolean, or null; reference props carry a node id as string. Arrays and nested objects are not allowed in v1 — multi-valued information is reified as nodes/edges.
